rationale: The stock has already gapped up ~6.7% on strong earnings and is trading at 81% of today's range after a significant intraday run, with the 9-EMA ($71.53) now above price and the last four 1-minute candles showing a clear step-down from $71.52 to $71.12 with a high-volume flush candle (23k shares) suggesting distribution. The broad market is under significant pressure (SPY -1.85%, VIXY +12.39%), which creates headwinds for further upside on a stock that has already priced in the earnings beat. With 137 minutes to close and no clear momentum in either direction — just a decelerating post-gap drift — the risk/reward for both long and short entries is unfavorable given the noise and potential for mean reversion toward VWAP ($69.45) or a squeeze back toward the high.
